title: System Test Engineer II
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

About the Role

Dedrone systems sit at the bleeding edge of counter-UAS (CUAS) capability. You'll design and execute the test strategies that prove them out, across hardware/software integration, networking, active and passive detection, computer vision, RF mitigation/defeat, environmental durability, and automated regression. You'll be the engineer who understands the entire system and its nuances end to end: you'll determine whether a system has what it takes to meet the objective, build the tooling to evaluate it against live drone threats, and be the one who can reproduce the issue nobody else can. Your job is to make sure the systems our customers rely on hold up in the real world, against real threats, at the forefront of technology.

In this role the drone is the threat . What's under test is the CUAS stack - detect, track, identify, and defeat - along with the sensors, software, integrations, and platforms that deliver it.

What You'll Do

• Own system-level test strategy for one or more CUAS product lines, from early prototype through production and field deployment.

• Design and execute integration test plans across the full stack: RF sensors, radar, EO/IR and acoustic sensors, computer vision, RF detection/DF, jamming and mitigation/defeat, networking, radios, and third-party system integrations.

• Plan and execute field test campaigns at the range - flying threat-representative target drones against the system and executing live detect-track-ID-defeat runs.

• Build and maintain test tooling, automation, and instrumented data capture and reduction, regression automation, and HIL / RF-chamber / environmental setups for sensor and platform hardware.

• Collect, analyze, and report test metrics, turn field data into clear insights, recommendations, and event reports for PM, engineering, and leadership.

• Evaluate third-party and integrated systems against defined acceptance criteria to determine whether a system or integration meets the cut.

• Triage complex multi-system failures across HW, FW, SW, RF, and network; reproduce intermittent field issues others can't.

• Partner with various Dedrone teams during design reviews to bake in testability early.

• Help shape the System Test and Evaluation discipline across Dedrone.

What You Bring

Required

• BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Aerospace, or a related field - or equivalent hands-on experience. We actively welcome non-traditional paths: prior technician, electrician, military technical-trade experience followed by a degree is a strength, not a gap.

• 5-8 years across system test, system integration, field test & evaluation, or hands-on technical roles (military or industry) on complex electromechanical and RF systems.

• Hands-on with at least two of: HW/SW integration testing, RF/wireless validation, environmental/reliability testing, test automation, electrical system testing, radar testing, EO/IR or camera testing, acoustic sensing.

• Demonstrated ability to debug across the stack - hardware, electrical, RF, network, and software.

• Comfortable owning field operations and translating raw test data into decisions stakeholders can act on.

• U.S. person defined as a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent residents (Green Card holders)

• Approximately 50% field time

Strongly preferred

• CUAS, EW/SIGINT, RF, Cameras, Radar or other mission-critical / safety-critical

The Team & Our Story

We are a global team of founders, operators and engineers, obsessed with building the best products. We work at the cutting edge of financial innovation, using stablecoins to create tools for consumers and businesses.
We operate with trust, clarity, and ambition: own your craft, move with urgency, contribute beyond your lane, back your teammates, debate rigorously, and keep raising the bar for what great means.

• Consumer owns the core Plasma One product experience - onboarding, activation, retention, rewards, tiers, trading, earn, and account management. The team is responsible for growing funded users, engagement, balances, spend, and long-term retention.

• Payments owns the financial infrastructure that powers Plasma - accounts, ledgers, funding, payouts, card issuing, reconciliation, payment orchestration, and currency/rail integrations. The team is responsible for the reliability, scalability, and economics of moving and storing money.

• Business owns the Plasma experience for companies - the operating account for businesses that work globally: onboarding, receiving, holding, and sending money across borders, corporate cards and spend management, and the roles and approvals that keep teams in control of company money. • Own the hardest technical problems inside your team end to end - the ones that need deep judgment, not just execution.
